name: SikaInject-867

SIKAINJECT®-867: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaInject®-867, October 2024, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikainject-867.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaInject®-867 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2024, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaInject®-867 is a thixotropic, high yield, and shrinkage compensated grout used for placement of cable and rock bolts in tunnels and underground mines
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaInject®-867 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - SikaInject®-867 is particularly suitable as a grout used for the encapsulation of roof bolts and cable anchors where the “top-down” grouting method is preferred.
    - SikaInject®-867 has been specially developed to give a high yield (volume) of grout without segregation or bleed whilst providing excellent compressive strengths.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaInject®-867
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High yield thixotropic cable bolt grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2024, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.2: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Highly pumpable; yet, exhibits rapid thixotropy
    - Can be applied through small-diameter grout tubes
    - Excellent strength development
    - Extended working time (~60 min at 20 °C)
    - Excellent bond to steel and surrounding strata
    - Restricted flow into surrounding strata
    - Enables the use of smaller drill holes
    - Eliminates the requirement for sealing of the collar and plate with cotton waste etc.
    - Economical to use
    - Enhances the safety of critical bolt and anchor installations
2.5 Compressive strength.
    | 24 Hours | 7 Days | 28 Days |
    | 6.0 litres water | ~ 30 MPa | ~ 55 MPa | ~ 65 MPa |
    | per 20kg |
    | 6.5 litres water | ~ 25 MPa | ~ 50 MPa | ~ 60 MPa |
    | per 20kg |
    | 7.0 litres water | ~ 23 MPa | ~ 45 MPa | ~ 55 MPa |
    | per 20kg |
    | 7.5 litres water | ~ 20 MPa | ~ 40 MPa | ~ 50 MPa |
    | per 20kg |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    AS1478.2 Appendix A. restrained 50 mm cubes at 23°C, Age Typical compressive strength. Strength development depends on the amount of mixing water, ambient temperature, age and curing of the grout mixture. Actual results may vary.
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20 kg bag
    - Shelf life: 12 months from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: Store properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10 °C and +35 °C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2024, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2024, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Yield: Mixing 20 kg grout with 6.5L water = ~ 13L of grout mixture
4.3 Equipment. For best results, a high mechanical shear mixer or a paddle mixer should be used. The grout pump must have accurate water dosing capabilities.
4.4 Mixing.
    - SikaInject®-867 is supplied ready to use; requiring only the addition of potable water.
    - Fill the mixer with the correct amount of water that matches the number of SikaInject®-867 bags. As a guide, use 6.0 - 7.5L of water per 20 kg bag of SikaInject®-867 grout for a thixotropic mixture. The actual amount of water required will depend on the desired consistency of the grout mixture and the grout pump available. Do not exceed the amount of water recommended for obtaining thixotropic mixtures. Start the mixer after adding the required amount of water. Slowly add SikaInject®-867 grout powder. Continue mixing until a thick, creamy, no-lump consistency is obtained. Discard any grout mixture that has been left unattended for more than 60 minutes. Do not retemper.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. As with all grouting operations, it is essential to systematically clean the pump and grout lines with clean water. This should be done immediately after completion of grouting operations. If the grouting operations delay for more than an hour, the batched grout mixture should be discarded, and the pump and grout lines cleaned.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2024, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaInject®-867, October 2024, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikainject-867.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: sds-sikainject-867au, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/3fc325ca-055e-4a18-b79a-42e202defe51_au01/sds-sikainject-867au.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
